# International Finance Corporation (IFC)

> IFC mobilizes private investment in emerging markets to create jobs, build sustainable infrastructure, and unlock economic growth across developing countries.

The International Finance Corporation is the private sector arm of the World Bank Group, operating for over 60 years to finance development projects through loans, equity investments, blended finance, and advisory services. IFC works across emerging markets to support climate action, gender equality, private sector development, and inclusive growth while maintaining rigorous sustainability and accountability standards.

## Core Mission & Services

- [Who We Are](https://www.ifc.org/en/about): IFC organizational overview: mission, vision, and development impact focus
- [What We Do](https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do): IFC core services: investments, job creation, and market development
- [Products and Services](https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do/products-and-services): IFC investment products: loans, equity, blended finance, advisory services
- [International Finance Corporation (IFC) Homepage](https://www.ifc.org/en/home): IFC homepage: 60+ years unlocking private investment in emerging markets

## Sector Expertise & Focus Areas

- [Climate Business](https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do/sector-expertise/climate-business): IFC climate finance: bankable projects and low-carbon resilient growth
- [Gender Equality and Economic Inclusion](https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do/sector-expertise/gender): IFC gender equality strategy: women entrepreneurs and economic inclusion
- [Private Capital Mobilization](https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do/sector-expertise/mobilizing-private-capital): IFC private capital mobilization through blended finance and syndications
- [Fragile and Conflict-Affected Situations](https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do/sector-expertise/fragile-and-conflict-affected-situations): IFC engagement in fragile and conflict-affected countries for economic growth
- [Sustainability](https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do/topics/sustainability): IFC sustainability framework: ESG standards and performance standards

## Organization & Leadership

- [Leadership](https://www.ifc.org/en/about/leadership): IFC management team and executive leadership directory and biographies
- [Partnerships](https://www.ifc.org/en/about/partnerships): IFC partnerships with UN, OECD, World Bank for development impact
- [Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion](https://www.ifc.org/en/about/diversity-equity-inclusion): IFC workplace culture: diversity, equity, inclusion, and anti-racism commitments
- [Accountability](https://www.ifc.org/en/about/accountability): IFC accountability mechanisms, compliance ombudsman, and grievance processes

## Research, Insights & Reporting

- [Insights & Reports](https://www.ifc.org/en/insights-reports): IFC research reports on emerging markets, infrastructure, and development finance
